issue.title: STAGE 02.2 — Fix PNG resource picker exclusive window conflict
issue.body:
# GO_FLORA Stage 02.2 — Fix exclusive resource-picker popup collision

**Priority:** BLOCKER / owner-observed real Godot GUI FAIL  
**Parent:** Stage 02 [#5](https://github.com/alekseypilishkov-gif/go_flora/issues/5); Stage 02.1 UI [#7](https://github.com/alekseypilishkov-gif/go_flora/issues/7)  
**Current plugin:** 0.2.1-dev  
**Existing branch/PR:** `codex/stage-02-imported-alpha` → Draft [PR #6](https://github.com/alekseypilishkov-gif/go_flora/pull/6), HEAD at report `1c61bf1fcd059cfb4d559eeabac806c684ecfddb`  
**Target:** 0.2.2-dev **hotfix on same PR #6** (do not start Stage 03 / do not release or merge)  
**Engine:** Godot **4.7.2.stable.official**, Windows (owner's TEST_FLORA uses this exact version)  
**Evidence location:** `stages/02_imported_alpha_vegetation/updates/02_resource_picker_modal_fix/`

## Owner-observed problem (REAL GUI, not theoretical)

Owner reports repeated errors **when trying to select a transparent PNG to create grass or flower from `Create Alpha Plant…`**. Output includes this exact engine diagnostic three times with different `ConfirmationDialog` IDs:

```text
ERROR: scene/main/window.cpp:1160 - Attempting to make child window exclusive, but the parent window already has another exclusive child.
This window: /root/@EditorNode.../@EditorQuickOpenDialog...
parent window: /root
current exclusive child window: /root/@EditorNode.../@ConfirmationDialog...
```

Surrounding log shows `GO_FLORA_PLUGIN_ENABLED`, successful `GO_FLORA Add plant source` operations and numerous Paint/Erase commits (including >3000 records and later erase operations); **there is no evidence that the PNG parser failed or that existing logical records were lost**. Treat the blocked resource chooser as confirmed `OWNER_REPORTED_GUI_FAIL`; do not infer no failure merely because an Add plant source action was separately logged.

## Specific source-level finding

In current `addons/go_flora/editor/source_creator.gd`:

- The creator **extends `ConfirmationDialog`**; `EditorResourcePicker` (named `SourceAssetPicker`) sits inside.
- When the owner invokes `Quick Load…` from the resource picker, Godot's own `EditorQuickOpenDialog` tries to open as an **exclusive child of the root editor**, but a GO_FLORA `ConfirmationDialog` already occupies that exclusive slot.
- The same creator contains an `EditorFileDialog` child used via `_save.popup_centered_ratio(0.6)` from the creator's `confirmed` signal. Verify there isn't a second exclusive-popup conflict on **Save Source…**.
- `addons/go_flora/editor/plugin.gd` uses a GO_FLORA source creator child of the EditorInterface base control and calls `_creator.popup_centered()`. Other GO_FLORA diagnostics/help dialogs should not collide with one another or the native resource picker.

Primary cause is **nested competing exclusive editor windows**, not card mesh building or PNG alpha. On the exact 4.7.2 API, verify `Window.exclusive`, transient parent and popup behavior. Candidate approaches include making the source creator a non-exclusive editor-owned tool window or a dock-embedded editor panel, and presenting file save as a separate nonconflicting window. **Do not treat a speculative one-line `exclusive = false` change as sufficient without testing both resource selection and saving.**

## Expected fix

1. From **Create Alpha Plant…**, a user can choose an actual `res://fixtures/grass.png` or another project-local PNG/WebP through the **normal resource picker Quick Load/Load menu**, preview the image/UV and save a source `.tres` by pressing `Save Source…`. No exclusive-child error, dialog behind another modal, dead keyboard focus, accidental editor input/brush strokes, or frozen UI.
2. Repeat for `flower.png`, lossless `grass.webp`, and atlas region from `atlas.png`. The chosen image must remain selected after closing the editor picker, and `.tres` should contain the correct reference, kind `ALPHA_CARD`, card dimensions/UV, display_name, unique stable source_id. Successful save appends a named entry to selected `VegetationSet` with exactly one native undoable palette operation (no duplicates).
3. The same native file picker works in **Add Mesh / GLB / Scene…**, including selecting an imported GLB resource/PackedScene and saving `.tres`. The fix must not accidentally allow unsupported imported scenes to be silently flattened.
4. `Cancel`, window X, Escape, switching scenes/sets, and reopening the creator clean up every created dialog/control; no leaked exclusive windows/callbacks, no duplicate add/undo actions. Check Help / diagnostics dialogs too.
5. User can create resources then paint/erase/single and save/reopen; no change to placement IDs/schema, renderer, undo semantics, weighted Mix/Selected brush, palette enabled/weight, layout (right next to Inspector) or rus tooltips. Preserve old Stage 01/02 sources and `C:\Dev\TEST_FLORA` without automated changes.
6. Errors from unsupported/invalid asset files must remain actionable and preserve saved placements. Avoid blanket suppression of engine errors or making all modal dialogs global non-exclusive without assessing side effects.

## Verification

- Reproduce **before** on a copy of the current addon, ideally with actual native Editor GUI interaction: `Create Alpha Plant → Texture2D resource picker → Quick Load…` while parent ConfirmationDialog remains visible; capture console excerpt / window exclusivity and note exact user events.
- Add focused native Editor tests of creator/dialog lifecycle and window exclusivity. Test resource choosing and `Save Source` sequence at minimum; native API tests are distinct from physical mouse GUI.
- Repeat Stage 01 and 02 core/native suites and Stage 02.1 UX tests without weakening assertions; preserve all three CI checks, 18 GPU alpha-scissor pixel results, frozen saved records, scene persistence and ZIP checksum/backup.
- Provide owner-oriented manual GUI script with very explicit steps for choosing grass.png, flower.png, selecting files, Save Source, Cancel and repeated creation. If interactive automation unavailable: mark `INTERACTIVE_GUI_QA: NOT_RUN` and `READY_FOR_MANUAL_QA`, **not PASS**. Keep owner's observed old-build failure in evidence.
- Prepare a **plugin-only ZIP 0.2.2-dev** and adjacent JSON/SHA, update plugin and report. Do **not** install into owner's `C:\Dev\TEST_FLORA` or overwrite files. Owner will install manually through Windows Explorer; provide the full local archive path and precise extraction path `C:\Dev\TEST_FLORA\addons\go_flora`. No PowerShell instructions for owner.

**Stop:** commit to `codex/stage-02-imported-alpha`, update **existing Draft PR #6**, include Russian report & CI links, leave PR draft and pause for owner's GUI re-test. No merge/release/Stage 03.
